title: Story premise EDU055: The Five Almost-Finished Posters
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: Why are five busy canvases producing zero finished posters? Takeaway/theme: Limiting simultaneous work can make completion and blocked items easier to see.
description: A designer wants five completed posters, but keeps switching whenever a new idea appears. A visible limit on active drafts lets one poster cross the finish line before another enters.
